title: Bunny Eureka
description:
Build a Little Island Where Bunnies Live Their LivesThis is a gentle, low-pressure life simulation game about building a peaceful island village for cute bunnies. 

Place houses, plants, workshops, and play spaces, then watch the island slowly become a home where bunnies can work, rest, eat, and play.

There are no stressful goals or harsh punishments. You can plan the village carefully, or simply leave the game running and enjoy watching a small world move on its own through day and night.

Watch Bunny Daily LifeEach bunny has its own needs. They look for food, rest when tired, go to work, and spend their free time playing or joining small group activities. After finishing their workday, bunnies happily go off duty and find something else to do around the island.

You do not need to control every moment. A big part of the game is stepping back and watching the bunnies decide what they want to do next.

ᯓ 💌Remember to click the mailbox to read the adorable letters from the bunnies. Happy little bunnies love writing letters to humans!

Build, Farm, and ProduceYou can place, rotate, and remove buildings and plants on the island grid. Plants grow over time, and harvested resources can be carried to different facilities to become food or other products.

Some workshops need both ingredients and wood as energy. Assign bunnies to plant crops, care for trees, transport resources, and help the island’s little production chain come alive.

Work Is Only Part of LifeBunnies are not just workers. They get tired, need meals and rest, and enjoy their free time after work. Build beds, seats, play areas, and cozy places for them so the island feels less like a factory and more like a home.

Storybook VisitorsThe island also has small story moments. Visitors may arrive through the storybook, and the bunnies may gently care for humans who need help. More stories, interactions, and daily-life details will continue to grow as development continues.

For Players Who EnjoyCute animals, cozy building, light simulation, idle observation, and relaxing games with very little pressure.
If you enjoy watching a small world quietly take care of itself, Bunny Eureka is meant to bring you a soft little pocket of joy.

Ongoing DevelopmentMore features will be added based on player feedback. 
We look forward to growing Bunny Island together with you.
description_short: Build a peaceful island village for cute bunnies. Place homes, plants, workshops, and play spaces, assign gentle jobs, grow and process food, or simply leave the game running and watch the bunnies eat, sleep, work, play, and live their tiny everyday lives.
